description: Returns USDA FoodData Central nutrient values per 100 g (calories, protein, total fat, saturated fat, carbohydrate, fiber, total sugars, sodium) for a common recipe ingredient, with its FDC id, the USDA household measures (1 cup, 1 tbsp, 1 large, 1 clove) in grams, and optionally the nutrients for an amount such as 1.5 cup or 3 large. 406 ingredients from SR Legacy and Foundation Foods, embedded, no API key. Use it instead of estimating nutrition from memory.

amount.description: Optional amount to compute nutrients for, e.g. 1.5.

ingredient.description: Ingredient name, e.g. "cheddar cheese", "brown rice", "olive oil", "large egg".

unit.description: Unit for amount: g, oz, lb, kg, cup, tbsp, tsp, fl oz, ml, or "each" for a counted item (uses the USDA medium or large size). Default g.

name: lookup_ingredient_nutrition
title: Look up USDA nutrients for an ingredient
